## Problem

Describe the specific problem and why it belongs in SplitSeal.

## Change

Describe behavior and compatibility effects.

## Privacy and security

Explain effects on private records, membership disclosure, paths, keys, artifact schemas,
plugins, and dependencies. State `none` when there is no effect.

## Validation

- [ ] Tests use synthetic data only.
- [ ] `make check` passes.
- [ ] Package and clean-install checks pass when packaging changed.
- [ ] No key, seal, private path, private record, or sensitive log is included.
- [ ] Documentation and changelog are updated when behavior changed.
